# Savewave

## Overview

Savewave is a privacy-first local media downloader using the Paste → Resolve → Preview → Save workflow. The GitHub Pages deployment (https://savewave.kuberbassi.com/) is a lightweight installation landing page. All public-media extraction runs locally on user devices via `yt-dlp` and `FFmpeg`.

## Architecture & Surface

- **Shared Core**: TypeScript core handles URL source detection, capability gates, error normalization, quality policies, Spotify match scoring, and local IndexedDB history.
- **Desktop Client**: Tauri 2 application (Rust + WebView) running bundled `yt-dlp` and `FFmpeg` sidecars in isolated temporary jobs.
- **Android Client**: Native Android app (Kotlin) for Android 10+ with scoped `MediaStore` saving into `Downloads/Savewave`.
- **Supported Platforms**: Public YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Threads, X (Twitter), SoundCloud, Direct Links, and Spotify Smart Match metadata.
- **Restrictions**: Private, login-gated, cookie-only, paid, and DRM-protected media are not supported.

## Privacy & Security

- **No Cloud Services**: Zero user accounts, zero remote databases, zero media cloud storage, and zero media proxies.
- **On-Device Data**: Bounded download history remains local to the device and can be cleared at any time.
- **Safe Execution**: Structured command arguments prevent shell injection. Updates are notification-only via `client-version.json` with explicit user consent.
